newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile sells lead for avg $0.3463/lb.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile sells lead for avg $0.3463/lb.

text.p: The U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said Friday it sold 1,245 tonnes of surplus lead for an average $0.3463 per pound.
Hirsch Metals Corp of Boca Raton, Florida, bought 20 tonnes for $0.3625 per pound and 60 tonnes for $0.3575 per pound, the agency said.
M.C. Canfield Sons of Union, New Jersey, bought 60 tonnes for $0.3540 per pound. Parks Pioneer Metals Co of Milwaukee, Wisconsin, bought 20 tonnes for $0.3485 per pound.
Exide Corp bought 800 tonnes for $0.3450 per pound, and Schuylkill Metals Corp of Baton Rouge, Louisiana, bought 285tonnes for $0.3446 per pound.
